race.comment: BARBARIC LAD (12) fifth-up today with the key jockey change and desperate for a firmer surface. Won well two back, then anchored with the 60.5kg when a fading sixth over 1250m at Canterbury on the heavy surface. Building a good record and has solid each way claims in this tougher race. HIGH BLUE SEA (10) stalked the pace and failed to close off on the tricky surface when seventh over 1400m at Rosehill in this grade. Assess on earlier runs. FELIX MAJESTIC (7) can give plenty of cheek dropping back slightly in trip and having the blinkers removed. SO YOU PENCE (9) won the Barn Dance before a spell and her recent trial suggests she's up to the mark on resumption. Ticks plenty of boxes.
